sample_unit: intensivist raters evaluating two chatbot-generated tracheostomy consent drafts

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of chatbot-generated tracheostomy consent drafts
links.effect: ChatGPT drafts had higher FRE scores than Google Gemini (76.46 vs 60.04), indicating better readability; Gemini's drafts were less readable.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT drafts had higher FRE scores (76.46 vs 60.04), indicating better readability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the output quality (readability, accuracy, completeness, sentiment) of informed consent drafts generated by ChatGPT and Google Gemini for tracheostomy, judged offline by intensivists, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
